title: A message to another session that names a commit, record or PR that does not exist is caught
why: Lane notes-fix-large-1 sent runner 8 a record link it typed before the post returned, so the link pointed at nothing; it corrected it with a second message (coordinator, 02:12 CST Nov 8). Step agent-report-shas-resolve covers an agent's hand-back only, not send_message (that lane, 02:15 CST).
note: Fix: the commit-hash part may reuse agent-report-shas-resolve's function as a second caller on mcp__claude-code-remote__send_message, with a rule for which repo a hash resolves against (lanes often send hashes from another repo, so the sender's cwd alone gives false alarms). A record link or PR number needs a GitHub read in a PreToolUse hook, a network call on every send: state that cost, or check only the commit-hash part. Red case first: a message with a made-up hash. Built as a follow-up from #1842's head, stacked with Merge after: #1842, together with Fix lines for the four report-sha-* notes, in lane session_013NEJL1333yS5ziKFeWsjHC (coordinator, 02:30 CST Nov 8). Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from lane agent-report-shas-resolve (session_013NEJL1333yS5ziKFeWsjHC). Filed 02:16 CST Nov 8.
